Quick note from ops — when invites are created by a delegated service account GCal sometimes strips the organizer header during cross-domain sends, which causes recipient calendars to drop the event. Two practical options:

- Recreate the event from Rachel's primary account and re-send (best fix).
- Publish a separate Zoom meeting (standby) and include the link in the invite description + follow-up email (fastest workaround).

If you re-create the event, add the BrightPaths tech distribution (tech@brightpaths.com) as required attendees and include the Zoom link in the body. Also add an explicit .ics attachment (some Outlook clients rely on the attachment rather than the event).

I'm happy to re-create the event if you're tied up. Tell me which account to use and I'll do it now.

-Ben
